description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice of Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2063/15 of 19.03.2018 that published calling for Nominations for the appointment of Mediators (closing date 31.07.2018)
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the appointment of mediators for Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations and setting closing dates for mediator appointments in specific districts, which relates to the administration of dispute resolution mechanisms within the justice system. This fits Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) as it deals with court-related appointments and the functioning of quasi-judicial bodies.
